description: Maintain the do-not-contact list (emails and domains) and check values against it. Use when a prospect opts out, bounces, or asks not to be contacted. Domains suppress their subdomains too. The suppression list is honored by every outward tool and cannot be bypassed from a tool call. Free and local. add is idempotent; remove needs the exact value.
name: sdr_manage_suppression
title: Manage suppression
